title: Inter 1-0 Shakhtar: Martinez won it, not Carlos Augusto — Nerazzurri Daily No. 51
description:
Martinez won it for Inter, not Carlos Augusto — ten-man Inter beat Shakhtar Donetsk 1-0 at San Siro.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=51

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Oct 21): Inter 1-0 Shakhtar Donetsk. Carlos Augusto scored in the 77th minute, Alessandro Bastoni was sent off in the 68th for two yellow cards in two minutes, and Josep Martinez saved twice in the 88th.
CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Oct 21): Cristian Chivu called the win hugely important and said the side showed it can dig deep.
REPORTED (Corriere dello Sport via FCInterNews, Oct 22): four players miss Fiorentina on Sunday and Venezia on Wednesday — Lautaro Martinez, Benjamin Pavard, John Stones and Curtis Jones. Lautaro Martinez is not expected back before the break.
REPORTED (Sky Sport Italia, Oct 21): Mariani referees Inter against Fiorentina on Sunday, with Fabbri on VAR.

NEXT UP: Fiorentina at San Siro, Sunday, October 25 — 7:30 AM ET / 12:30 CET. US TV: CBSSN, Paramount+, Telemundo.
